function.name: run_automation
function.description: Trigger a Home Assistant automation with optional variables. Use this to manually trigger automations.

automation_id.description: The automation entity ID (e.g., 'automation.notify_on_motion' or just 'notify_on_motion')

variables.description: Variables to pass to the automation (available as trigger.variables)

skip_conditions.description: Whether to skip the automation's conditions (default: false)
